name: Helix GenoSphere
description: Bring Helix GenoSphere™ — a growing research clinico-genomic dataset of more than 500,000 exome-sequenced participants with linked longitudinal EHR data — directly into Claude. Query gene-level carrier counts and pathogenic variants, determine target genes on curated panels, search standardized medical vocabularies (conditions, drugs, labs), and obtain privacy-protected patient counts for any concept. All responses are aggregated and statistically de-identified, with small groups suppressed to protect participant privacy. A read-only window into population-scale genomics, no SQL required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Helix GenoSphere to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Helix GenoSphere to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hrn-production.helix.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Helix GenoSphere MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Helix GenoSphere provides these MCP tools: get_variant_frequency, check_gene_availability, get_dataset_overview, search_concepts, and get_patient_count.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Helix GenoSphere?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Helix GenoSphere in life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include AdisInsight, Boltz API, Inductive Bio, LatchBio, and Owkin.

_published_faq.name: Does Helix GenoSphere MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Helix GenoSphere requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Helix GenoSphere is developed by Helix. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
